Container.Name: Allseerr
Container.Overview: Allseerr is a free and open source request manager for your media server. Users can discover and request movies, series, music, books and audiobooks, and requests are sent to Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr and Chaptarr. It works with Jellyfin, Emby and Plex. Allseerr is based on Seerr.[br][br] [b]Permissions:[/b] the container runs as UID 1000 / GID 1000 and does not use PUID or PGID. Before the first start, make the appdata folder writable by that user, for example:[br] [code]mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/allseerr && chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/allseerr[/code]
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: seerr overseerr jellyseerr requests lidarr chaptarr readarr bazarr audiobookshelf music books audiobooks
Container.Changes:
### 3.5.2.6 (2026-11-27) - Narrator pages: a narrator's audiobooks grouped by author and series, and narrator search - Grimmory for ebooks and audiobooks, including User Access
### 3.5.2.5 (2026-11-22) - Sign in with your own OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak) - Multiple webhooks, Notify Me Too, genre blocks - Optional: users remove what only they requested, Not Found after X days, unwatched request limit, watched cleanup page - Tracearr watch history, Advanced Requests options per user
### 3.5.2.4 (2026-11-19) - Book requests no longer fail when Chaptarr has not prepared the book yet - A refused request now says why
### 3.5.2.3 (2026-11-18) - Faster combined search
Full changelog: https://github.com/DanCue44/Allseerr/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
